messages:
Ivy (AE): Heads up deal desk request: Helio Robotics wants Dedicated Reserved for 12 months. List is $980k/yr. They asked for a custom term: 40% off, net60, and 4-week implementation credit. They claim pilot proofs and will be referenceable. Need guidance on approval path — can we escalate?

Jordan (Finance): 40% is well above our standard. What's the proposed net revenue and estimated incremental cost? Any partner or investor guarantee?

Ivy (AE): Ask: 40% -> $588k/yr. No investor guarantee, but they said CTO will sign a PO. They offered a 2x expansion target in 12 months and exclusive case study. Sales suggests 30% + 30% upfront deposit as compromise.

Kai (Sales Ops): Quick calc: list 980k, 30% -> 686k, 40% -> 588k. Estimated incremental cost (infra+support) ~160k. Margin at 30% disc ~526k (60%); at 40% disc ~428k (57%). Fiscally possible but sets precedent. Recommend requiring 30% deposit for >25% discounts.

Riley (Legal): We can accept net60 if signatory is authorized and we add late payment interest. Implementation credit should be capped and scoped; any dev work outside scope billed separately. Also need to add termination and IP clauses. Legal turnaround ~48 hrs.

Jordan (Finance): For CFO escalation: submit deal desk with final proposed price, deposit plan, credit check outcome, and SRE note on implementation impact. Finance can approve up to 30% with 30% deposit + credit OK. Anything >30% needs Marin sign-off.

Ivy (AE): I'll push for 30% deposit today and try to get PO signed by CTO. Can we do 30% now with a renewal clause that disallows deeper renewal discounts?

Marin (CFO): I can approve exceptions up to 30% under conditions: 30% non-refundable deposit, credit/PO verification, capped implementation credit, and margin floor >= 45% after incremental costs. I will NOT approve 40% without exec committee justification. Document all conditions in ticket.

Kai (Sales Ops): Adding renewal guardrail to deal desk: renewals default to list unless a renewal discount is explicitly approved by Finance.

Riley (Legal): Noted. I'll prepare redline template with implementation credit and payment protections.

Ivy (AE): Thanks everyone — I'll update the ticket and chase deposit + PO. Will ping @Marin if customer insists on 40% and provides exec-level justification. :thumbsup: 

Jordan (Finance): Marking as "needs CFO sign-off" if 40% requested; otherwise "in flight" for 30% path.
